_comment: PMTiles source registry for Daxelo Kinrel map. Each entry defines the PMTiles archive URL for a coverage phase. The Flutter app reads the 'active' field to know which source to use.
_comment_2: During Phase A dev: use 'mumbai_local'. For prod: switch to 'mumbai_cf' once uploaded to Cloudflare R2.

mumbai_cf._comment: Cloudflare R2 prod (Phase A target once verified)

monaco_local._comment: Pipeline test — Monaco is tiny (~2MB), use for end-to-end verification

openfreemap_fallback._comment: Original OpenFreeMap source — kept as a fallback if PMTiles source fails to load
